annotations.title: Inspect an x402 payment offer without paying

description: Inspect an x402 payment offer without paying. Use when an agent is about to pay an HTTP 402 resource and needs to see the x402 offers first: network, asset, price in dollars for recognised USD stablecoins, payTo, scheme, and any malformed field. No payment is signed or sent. Cost: 1 credit per call.

method.description: GET (the default) or POST. A POST is sent only when a GET of the same URL already answered with a payment challenge, or the site's own /openapi.json declares a paid POST at that path, and always with an empty body. Otherwise the GET's answer is returned and post_skipped is true.

url.description: The public http(s) resource to inspect.

name: x402_inspect
